name: buggy-sim
$comment: The drivable buggy on the rolling hills of buggy-hills, with the FMU interface of the car-sim host as export markers: inputs steer, throttle, brake, reverse, handbrake and the friction scale per wheel; outputs the chassis and carrier poses, spin angles, tyre and suspension states, telemetry, motor and battery. A short test drive feeds the inputs in bg-sim. Generated by design/build_model.py.

parameters.name: soc0
parameters.description: Battery state of charge at the start (0..1)

parameters.name: x0
parameters.description: Start position of the chassis CG, world x

parameters.name: z0
parameters.description: Start height of the chassis CG (the static ride height over the ground under the wheels plus a little: the car drops onto its wheels)

options.text: The buggy with the car-sim interface on the hills. In bg-sim a short test drive feeds the inputs; in the FMU the host drives.
